interns.name: Alibaba Group
interns.description:
- Deployed local SD1.5 pipeline and built full-stack web system for avatar generation. Constructed mapping rules from structured parameters to diffusion prompts, and
benchmarked
performance and hardware requirements of mainstream generative models including Stable Diffusion and Flux. - Leveraged Hy-MT2-7B and Qwen3-4B models to optimize prompt engineering. Designed
incremental semantic merging strategies
to resolve semantic conflicts and redundant descriptions in multi-round generation, and summarized stable model tuning solutions through comparative tests of CFG scale, sampling steps and seed parameters. - Implemented
T2I
and
img2img
generation pipelines, and adapted dual inference backends including local Stable Diffusion and ComfyUI. Designed interface fields for historical prompts, incremental instructions and denoising strength to support end-to-end iterative image editing with subject consistency. - Optimized denoising strength thresholds for img2img iteration. Established classification rules for instruction addition, replacement and deletion to mitigate feature drift and semantic conflicts, improving the stability and accuracy of iterative image modification. - Conducted
full-scene testing
and
iterative optimization
of multimodal generation system. Built prompt conflict resolution mechanisms based on hard constraints and user latest intentions, and sorted out test cases and regression documents to enhance system stability and maintainability.

interns.name: China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd
interns.description:
- Synthesized industry and internal case materials on distressed asset resolution (e.g., debt-to-equity swaps, auctions, restructurings) and distilled key risk factors into reusable briefings for internal reference.
- Compiled and standardized annual report data across 18 financial institutions including banks, AMCs and brokers, extracting and consolidating key financial and disclosure items into structured datasets for analysis.
- Performed basic cross-company and time-series comparisons (leverage, liquidity, profitability quality, impairments, contingencies) and drafted concise risk highlights to support internal documentation.
- Operated under strict data-access and compliance constraints, focusing on public disclosures and documentation workflows to improve traceability and retrieval efficiency.
